calculation.description: Contrarian signal assigning higher values to assets with negative recent five-day returns, scaled by trailing 20-day realized volatility. Signal uses only completed prices through t and predicts forward cross-sectional returns.

signal_artifact.data_alignment: Prices aligned on union of available dates and forward-filled; signal at t uses data through t only; forward return begins at t+1.

metrics.correlation_note: Not computed in this cycle; deterministic post-Miner gate must recompute from signal artifacts.

validation.regime_notes: Daily signal is positive in all reported regimes: 2020-2022 IC 0.040240, ICIR 0.124053 (1075 dates); 2023-2024 IC 0.020966, ICIR 0.064383 (731 dates); 2025-2026 IC 0.026952, ICIR 0.084859 (590 dates). The 2023-2024 subperiod is below the ICIR gate, so regime stability is mixed despite passing full-sample admission. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
